## 71982ba2b59e

**Reproduced contract gap with a suspected canonical shortcut.** All five canonical demonstrations are also fit by the simpler proxy “two components are shape-equivalent when they have the same cell count and the same unordered bounding-box dimensions.” That proxy need not test rotation-normalized cell occupancy and is therefore weaker than the intended relation.

A lawful generated hard example at seed `700002`, sample index `34` disproves the proxy. It passes `self_check`, observes six components/two colors/`precedence`, and its actual Racket matrix differs from the proxy matrix. The full grid, component features, both outputs, canonical fit count, hashes, and apply command are in `checks/audit/71982ba2b59e/counterexample.json`.

This does **not** show that the present sampler can never teach the correct relation; the retained sample proves it sometimes emits the needed counterexample. The reproduced repository defect is that no executable semantic contract requires each lesson to refute this or another declared rival. The official `semantic_gate` therefore fails with “no semantic contract declared”; see `checks/audit/71982ba2b59e/semantic-stage/checks/71982ba2b59e_after_semantic_gate.log`.

**Patch status:** audit only; no files for `71982ba2b59e` were changed.
